question: If I cast Frogmyr Enforcer for its prototype cost, does its affinity for artifacts still reduce what I pay?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: affinity for artifacts still applies when it is cast prototyped.
expected.answer: When casting Frogmyr Enforcer prototyped, its affinity for artifacts ability will still apply.

whyHard: Prototype changes the mana cost, so players think the other cost-changing abilities are switched off.
